ref: ADR-0004 "An absent parent gives zero contexts, not one empty context" (assumed reading, Consequences); with no context there is nothing to replace with "", and the one result context holds no value, as with removeContexts (fn/removeContexts/003)
note: An empty input: <Orders/> has no Order, so Qty in context Order has no context at all, not one empty context. collapseContexts gives one context with no value, and the root's one slot creates no All. If a missing context counted as an empty one, All would be one empty element.
